description: The file contains CSS variables and styles for managing themes in a web application, specifically for light and dark modes. It includes styles for various classes related to the app's layout and theme-related button interactions.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application that centers its content and manages background color based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Style for the application logo, including animation and size attributes.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application, styled with background colors and flexbox layout.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for links within the App component, particularly with respect to theme colors.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button that allows users to switch between light and dark themes.
